title: Webb & Zapata DA's Office Joins Career Day at LBJ High School
excerpt: Assistant District Attorneys Lauren Ramirez and Rebecca Garza were invited to Career Day at LBJ High School on Friday morning, sharing a look at careers in the District Attorney's Office with Laredo students.
content:
The Webb & Zapata County District Attorney's Office took part in Career Day at LBJ High School in Laredo on Friday morning, Nov. 13.

Assistant District Attorneys Lauren Ramirez and Rebecca Garza were invited to the event, where they spoke with students about careers in the District Attorney's Office and the work prosecutors do for Webb and Zapata counties.

Career Day gives students a chance to hear directly from people working in the community about the paths that led them to their jobs — and what those jobs look like day to day.

Source: Webb & Zapata DA's Office (Facebook), Nov. 13, 2026.
